name: Good ol' Gil Giggles
source:
Good ol' Gil Giggles is a hotblooded resistance ranger who is always starting arguments. He considers himself a rival to [url=/c143276]Flippy[/url] due to believing himself to be the superior leader. 

[spoiler]He hates Flippy due to his motive dream telling him Flippy started an illegal draft.[/spoiler]
